tasks.listening-speaking-t4: Generate Grade 6 isiXhosa SAL Term 4 multiple-choice items for Listening and Speaking about health, feelings, celebrations, short revision dialogues, and brief prepared talks. Emphasise polite listening responses, familiar oral vocabulary recall, identifying suitable speaking strategies, and choosing effective openings and closings for short oral presentations.
tasks.reading-viewing-t4: Generate Grade 6 isiXhosa SAL Term 4 multiple-choice items for Reading and Viewing using mixed familiar texts such as notices, short stories, and revision comprehension passages. Emphasise identifying main ideas, locating key details, making simple inferences, selecting strong summaries, and applying basic skimming and scanning strategies.
tasks.writing-presenting-t4: Generate Grade 6 isiXhosa SAL Term 4 multiple-choice items for Writing and Presenting about personal paragraphs, short reviews, simple messages, revision writing tasks, and picture-based writing. Emphasise organising ideas logically, matching tone and purpose to audience, selecting relevant vocabulary, and applying editing checks for punctuation and spelling.
tasks.language-structures-t4: Generate Grade 6 isiXhosa SAL Term 4 multiple-choice items for Language Structures and Conventions revising pronouns, basic concord agreement, tense forms, punctuation, and spelling in context. Emphasise sentence correction, grammar choice accuracy, error spotting, and consolidating year-end language knowledge for assessment readiness.
